components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact tactile action used for the main next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-sans-iansui); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); transition: background 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action with a paper surface and hairline edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-sans-iansui); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); transition: background 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Editorial Text Field
components.description: An underline-only field that stays part of the editorial page rhythm.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-field-label { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 10px/1.25 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 18px/1.5 var(--font-sans-iansui); transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 40%, transparent); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Compact route links with technical indexes and a green active mark.
components.html: N°01文章N°02關於N°03聯絡
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 4px 6px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans-iansui); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link span { margin-right: 4px; font: 400 9px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.1em; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 6px; bottom: -2px; left: 6px; height: 1px; background: var(--primary); }

components.name: Article Row
components.description: The main article index pattern: number, reading copy, and a directional arrow.
components.html: N°01一篇技術文章的標題清楚說明文章會幫助讀者理解什麼。2026.08.19 · 5 MIN READ
components.css: .ds-article-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 32px; padding: 32px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-article-number { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-mono); } .ds-article-copy { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-article-copy strong { font: 600 24px/1.375 var(--font-sans-iansui); transition: color 300ms; } .ds-article-copy small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-sans-iansui); } .ds-article-copy em { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: normal 400 10px/1.25 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-article-row svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 60%, transparent); transition: color 300ms, transform 300ms; } .ds-article-row:hover strong, .ds-article-row:hover svg { color: var(--primary); } .ds-article-row:hover svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-article-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: A quiet segmented control with a tactile active surface.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; height: 36px; align-items: center; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 8px); background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-tab { height: calc(100% - 1px); padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-sans-iansui); transition: color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--background); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--primary); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Reaction Chip
components.description: A friendly pill-shaped article reaction with a quiet count.
components.css: .ds-reaction { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-reaction span { font-size: 18px; } .ds-reaction small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1 var(--font-sans-iansui); } .ds-reaction:hover, .ds-reaction[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); } .ds-reaction:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Vartifact feels like a carefully kept personal journal for the web. It combines the clarity of technical documentation with the warmth of paper, personal notes, and authored observations. The design is calm and editorial, but it should never feel cold or corporate.

The system uses large confident titles, long comfortable reading rhythm, quiet hairline dividers, and small monospaced labels. Green is used as ink: a focused signal for active states, punctuation, links, and meaningful actions. Soft shadows give buttons, cards, and floating controls a friendly tactile response without turning the site into a layered application dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper-like surfaces with dark natural ink.
Large editorial titles paired with small technical labels.
Generous reading space inside a compact 64rem page frame.
Hairline structure, gentle corners, and restrained soft depth.
Calm motion that supports reading and respects reduced-motion settings.

rules.name: The Green Ink Rule
rules.body: Evergreen Ink is a focused signal, not a large decorative field. Keep it rare enough that active states and links remain meaningful.

rules.name: The Paper and Moss Rule
rules.body: Light mode feels like Soft Parchment; dark mode feels like Charcoal Moss. Do not replace either theme with pure white or pure black.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the sans family for human reading and JetBrains Mono for structure, metadata, indexes, and system labels.

rules.name: The Tight Title Rule
rules.body: Large headings use close tracking and compact line height; body copy restores open rhythm for reading.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes protect line length and reading rhythm before they add decoration or density.

rules.name: The Soft Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows show touch, focus, or floating hierarchy. They do not decorate static page sections.

dos: Do put article titles and reading content first.
Do use Soft Parchment, Charcoal Moss, and natural ink colors instead of sterile white and black.
Do use JetBrains Mono for small structural labels and metadata.
Do use one-pixel dividers and generous vertical rhythm to organize pages.
Do keep hover motion small, purposeful, and between 150ms and 300ms.
Do preserve visible focus states and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't make the site look like a corporate dashboard with dense panels, charts, or application chrome.
Don't use neon colors, glowing cyber effects, or loud technology gradients.
Don't turn every section into a card.
Don't use large green backgrounds when a small green signal is enough.
Don't replace the warm editorial rhythm with cramped utility layouts.
